Game Overview

Rolling Skibidi is a action title where navigate the chaotic downhill adventure of Rolling Skibidi as you steer a barrel-bound Skibidi through treacherous terrain. Master the simple yet demanding one-touch controls to dodge trees, boulders, and wildlife. Every quick tap keeps you rolling longer in this wacky, obstacle-filled escapade!
